title: Add 'Glass Option' selectable field to vehicle inspection reports

requirements.text: Add a new persisted field named "glassOption" to vehicle inspection records, and expose it through all relevant backend public/input types and APIs.

quotes:

Left Front Door Glass			
Right Front Door Glass			
Left Rear Door Glass			
Right Rear Door Glass

acceptanceCriteria: Motoko types are updated to include a new `glassOption : Text` field in `VehicleInspection`, `VehicleInspectionInput`, and `VehicleInspectionPublic`.
`submitInspection` stores the provided `glassOption` value into the persisted inspection.
Existing query methods (`getInspection`, `getAllInspections`, `getInspectionsByStatus`, `getInspectionsByInspector`) return `glassOption` as part of the inspection object returned to the frontend.
Backend candid bindings regenerate cleanly so the frontend can import the updated types without type errors.

requirements.text: Implement a state migration for existing stored inspections to safely initialize the new "glassOption" field during upgrade.

acceptanceCriteria: A conditional `backend/migration.mo` is added/updated per the project migration policy to populate `glassOption` for existing `VehicleInspection` records.
After upgrade, previously created inspections remain readable and do not trap due to missing `glassOption`.
A sensible default is applied for old records (e.g., empty text) when no value existed previously.

requirements.text: Add a "Glass Option" field to the New Vehicle Inspection form as a required dropdown with the following selectable values: Rear Wind Shield Glass, Front Wind Shield Glass, Left Front Door Glass, Right Front Door Glass, Left Rear Door Glass, Right Rear Door Glass. Submit the selected value to the backend as part of the inspection payload.

acceptanceCriteria: The dropdown options exactly match: "Rear Wind Shield Glass", "Front Wind Shield Glass", "Left Front Door Glass", "Right Front Door Glass", "Left Rear Door Glass", "Right Rear Door Glass".
Form validation prevents submission if Glass Option is not selected, and the existing validation/toast messaging remains user-friendly and in English.
The `useSubmitInspection` mutation is called with the new `glassOption` field included in the `VehicleInspectionInput` payload.

requirements.text: Display the selected "Glass Option" value in inspection detail views and in the formal printable report view.

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/InspectionDetailsDialog.tsx` shows a "Glass Option" row/value for an inspection.
`frontend/src/components/FormalReportView.tsx` includes "Glass Option" in the "Vehicle Information" section (or an equivalent appropriate section) for printing/PDF.
If an older inspection has no value (default), the UI displays a clear English fallback (e.g., "Not specified") without crashing.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; keep logic in `backend/main.mo`.
Only create/update `backend/migration.mo` when required for schema/state upgrades, following the conditional migration policy.
Do not modify files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not add or change camera capture, camera settings, or photo upload functionality (already covered by existing features).
Do not add new roles, authentication methods, or permissions changes.
Do not introduce external databases or third-party services.
